definitions.gloss: display shelf; display rack; exhibition shelf
definitions.explanation: A shelf or rack used to display merchandise in stores, museums, or exhibitions. Unlike a showcase, it is typically open without glass enclosure.

examples.japanese: {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}に{商品|しょうひん}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: To arrange products on the display shelf.

examples.japanese: {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}の{上|うえ}の{段|だん}にある{本|ほん}に{手|て}が{届|とど}かない。
examples.english: I can't reach the books on the upper shelf of the display rack.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}を{目立|めだ}つ{位置|いち}の{陳列棚|ちんれつだな}に{配置|はいち}して、{売|う}り{上|あ}げを{伸|の}ばした。
examples.english: We placed the new products on a display shelf in a prominent location and increased sales.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in retail and exhibition contexts. The base word {陳列|ちんれつ} means display or exhibition. More formal than simply saying {棚|たな} (shelf).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}に{並|なら}べる (to line up on a display shelf)
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}を{整理|せいり}する (to organize the display shelf)
- {陳列棚|ちんれつだな}から{取|と}る (to take from the display shelf)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ショーケース: showcase — an enclosed glass display case
- {棚|たな}: shelf — the general word for any shelf
